items.briefing:
Australian authorities have reached out to more than 10,000 Australians as part of an international cryptocurrency scam investigation — if you receive contact from the National Anti-Scam Centre, take it seriously and review any crypto-related transactions you've made recently. Separately, Troy Hunt's latest update covers cyber ransoms, a reminder that ransomware remains a real threat to organisations of all sizes, including training providers.

On the AI front, a new study found only 5% of staff use generative AI effectively — meaning most are either avoiding it or using it poorly. **Practical tip:** If you use AI tools like ChatGPT for work tasks, always review the output carefully before sharing or acting on it — AI can confidently produce incorrect information.

featured.title: National Anti-Scam Centre contacts more than 10,000 Australians following international cryptocurrency scam investigation - Scamwatch
featured.quote: Over 10,000 Australians targeted in international cryptocurrency scam—direct threat to local citizens.
